      "description": "CONTENT WARNINGS: grief/bereavement, animal injury, 1x jump scare. Perched on a rain-battered cliff edge is a former lighthouse; now a charming, boutique hotel. But when they do, to Beth's horror, it is a figure from a past she has tried to forget. Keira.
